records.title: Bestial Incantations
records.description:
Bestial incantations, also known as beast incantations, are a type of Incantation in Elden Ring. They are used primarily by Gurranq, Beast Clergyman and the Vulgar Militia. These incantations harness the primal power of beasts, focusing on robustness, healing, and delivering devastating physical attacks. The Clawmark Seal and Cinquedea both increase the effectiveness of offensive bestial incantations.
They all have a very low Faith requirement.

These incantations may summon powerful bloodflame to deal Fire damage. They require an investment in both Arcane and Faith to be cast.

records.title: Crucible
records.description: The Crucible (坩堝, Rutsubo), also known as the crucible of life (生命の坩堝), the golden Crucible (黄金の坩堝), or primordial crucible, was the primordial matter in which all life was blended together and the prior form of the Erdtree.

records.title: Crusade
records.description: The Crusade is an event in Shadow of the Erdtree, referring to Messmer's endless war against the hornsent in the Realm of Shadow.

records.title: Demigods
records.description: Demigods (デミゴッド, Demigoddo) are special beings found in the Lands Between. They are the majority of the primary characters in Elden Ring.

records.title: Divine Beast Incantations
records.description:
Divine Beast incantations, also known as divine beast invocations, are a type of Incantation in Shadow of the Erdtree. These incantations channel the primal powers of the Divine Beasts and Divine Bird Warriors, summoning storms, feathers, and spirits to attack foes or offer protection.
* Divine Beast Tornado is boosted by Divine Beast Head (4%), Divine Beast Helm (4%), Enraged Divine Beast (10%), and Godfrey Icon (15%)
* Divine Bird Feathers are boosted by Divine Bird Helm (10%)
* Watchful Spirit is boosted by Braided Cord Robe (15%)

records.title: Dragon Communion Incantations
records.description:
Dragon Communion Incantations are a subtype of Incantations in Elden Ring. These incantations are obtained by sacrificing the heart of a Dragon or Magma Wyrm, an act known as Dragon Communion.
The Dragon Communion Seal increases the damage of these spells by 15% when held in an active hand (32.25% if one is held in each hand).
Most of these spells require a moderate amount of both Faith and Arcane to wield, with the exception of Bayle's incantations, which instead have a high Arcane requirement.

records.title: Dragon Cult Incantations
records.description:
Dragon Cult incantations are a type of incantation in Elden Ring. These spells are characterized by their use of lightning and their association with the ancient dragons. They typically require a moderate to high Faith Attribute to cast.
The Gravel Stone Seal boosts the damage of these spells by 15% when held in an active hand (32.25% if one is held in each hand), not including Electrify Armament as it is a Weapon Buff spell.

records.title: Eclipse
records.description: The Eclipse is a recurring event mentioned in Elden Ring.

records.title: Elden Lord
records.description: Elden Lord is a title held by multiple characters in Elden Ring. It refers to individuals with great power who have stood before the Elden Ring.

records.title: Elden Ring (concept)
records.description: The Elden Ring (エルデンリング, Eruden Ringu) is a mysterious artifact that defines the world of Elden Ring itself. It is the source of the Erdtree, and its various interlocking runes represent and establish Order, the fundamental laws of the world.

records.title: Empyreans
records.description: are special Demigods with the potential to reach full godhood and forge a new Order. They are hand-selected by the Two Fingers to succeed the current god as vessel for the great Elden Ring. As such, they are important characters in the world of Elden Ring.

records.title: Erdtree
records.description:
The Erdtree (黄金樹, Ōgonju; lit. "Golden Tree") is a giant, gold-colored
tree that towers above the Lands Between in Elden Ring.

records.title: Erdtree Burial
records.location: Catacombs · Hero's Graves · Cathedral of the Forsaken
records.description: Erdtree Burial is part of the central religion in Elden Ring.

records.title: Erdtree Incantations
records.description: Erdtree Incantations, including ancient Erdtree incantations and Aspects of the Crucible, are a type of incantation in Elden Ring. These holy incantations are drawn from the power of the Erdtree and focus on blessings, healing, and primal aspects of the Crucible. The Erdtree Seal does not increases the effectiveness of Erdtree incantations.

records.title: Erdtree Worship Incantations
records.description: Erdtree Worship Incantations are a type of incantation in Elden Ring. They were used primarily by champions who defended and expanded the influence of Marika's Erdtree. These incantations focus on protection, enhancing abilities, and calling upon divine wrath in the form of golden energy. The Erdtree Seal does not increase the effectiveness of Erdtree incantations.

records.title: Eyes
records.description: Eyes are body parts in Elden Ring.

records.title: Fate

records.title: Flames
records.description: Flames are a common theme in the world of Elden Ring. Not limited to standard fire attacks, they come in a variety of colors with unique properties.

records.title: Frenzied Flame Incantations
records.description:
Frenzied Flame incantations, also known as Three Fingers incantations, are a type of Incantation in Elden Ring.
These incantations are used by the Chaos Followers of the Three Fingers to spread madness and destruction through the Frenzied Flame. The Frenzied Flame Seal increases the effectiveness of Frenzied Flame incantations by 20%.

records.title: Ghostflame
records.description: , also known as , is a cold-burning flame in Elden Ring. Characterized by its blue and white hue, it deals Magic damage and inflicts Frostbite buildup.

records.title: Giants' Flame
records.description:
The Giants' Flame (巨人の火, Kyojin no Hi), also referred to as the Flame of Ruin (滅びの火, Horobi no Hi) and the Flame of the Fell God (悪神の火, Akujin no Hi), is a divine element in Elden Ring.
The flame of ruin is an ancient and inextinguishable fire capable of burning even the Erdtree itself. This power of the fell god is wielded as Giants' Flame incantations by Fire Giants and Fire Monks.

records.title: Giants' Flame Incantations
records.description:
Giants' Flame incantations, also known as Flame incantations, are a type of Incantation spell in Elden Ring. These Fire-based incantations draw their power from the flame of ruin wielded by the Fire Giants of Flame Peak. They focus primarily on devastating attacks that can incinerate foes, unleash torrents of fire, or invoke protective flames to bolster the defenses and might of the caster. Many of these incantations demonstrate the raw, chaotic nature of fire, allowing for both area-of-effect damage and targeted assaults.
The Giant's Seal increases the effectiveness of offensive Giants' Flame incantations, except for Catch Flame, Fire's Deadly Sin, and Flame Sling.

records.title: Glintstone
records.description: Glintstone is a type of mineral in Elden Ring.

records.title: Glovewort
records.description: Gloveworts are a type of flower in Elden Ring.

records.title: God Hunt
records.description: The God Hunt was an event mentioned in Elden Ring.

records.title: Godslayer Incantations
records.description:
Godslayer Incantations, also known as Blackflame Incantations, are a group of six Incantations in Elden Ring and . They deal damage over time and offer protection or enhancements.
All offensive Godslayer Incantations deal Fire damage and inflict a Blackflame effect that deals additional damage equal to 2% of the target's maximum HP + 20 over the course of 2 seconds per hit (note that this doesn't stack, with another hit merely refreshing the duration). All bosses in Shadow of the Erdtree are resistant to this percentage-based damage, only taking damage equal to 1% of target's maximum HP + 10 over 2 seconds. Messmer the Impaler, Bayle the Dread, and the Promised Consort are even more resistant to the effect, only taking damage equal to 0.7% of target's maximum HP + 7.

records.title: Golden Order
records.description: The Golden Order (黄金律, Ōgonritsu) is a philosophical and theological movement in Elden Ring. It refers to the removal of the Rune of Death from the Elden Ring and the historic reign of Queen Marika the Eternal. Its greatest symbols are the Erdtree and the Grace of Gold. It is the dominant set of beliefs in the Lands Between.

records.title: Golden Order Incantations
records.description:
Golden Order Incantations, also known as Golden Order fundamentalist incantations, are a type of incantation spell in Elden Ring.
The incantations of the fundamentalists of the Golden Order focused on holy damage, protection, and the eradication of Those Who Live in Death. The Golden Order Seal and the Radiant Gold Mask increase the effectiveness of Golden Order incantations by 10%. The Dryleaf Seal increases the effectiveness by 15%, barring Litany of Proper Death. 
They each require a moderate amount of both Intelligence and Faith to cast, with the exception of Law of Causality and Law of Regression, both of which only require Intelligence.

records.title: Grace
records.description: Grace (祝福, Shukufuku), also referred to as the Grace of Gold (黄金の祝福, Ōgon no Shukufuku), is a blessing given to people throughout the Lands Between by the Elden Ring and the Erdtree that symbolizes its presence. This blessing is represented by a golden light in the eyes of the inhabitants of the Lands Between. Those who had grace bestowed on them, but later lost it, are known as Tarnished.

records.title: Grafting
records.description:
is a concept in Elden Ring involving the attachment of severed body parts onto another living being.
It is a blending, melding, or merging of life. It is a way to gain another's power through the attachment of severed limbs. Even the body parts of trolls and dragons could be grafted.

records.title: Greater Will
records.description:
The Greater Will is an unseen character in Elden Ring. It is a mysterious entity hailing from the lightless void and serving as the dominant force in Elden Ring and the history of the Lands Between. Its vassals and envoys are central to the Golden Order. Its image boosted Intelligence and Arcane. 
==Background== 
Long ago, the Greater Will fractured the One Great, creating births and souls. The adherents of the Three Fingers consider this action to be a mistake, because it resulted in torment, despair, affliction, sins, and curses.
The Greater Will sent a star bearing its gleaming daughter to the Lands Between. It communicated with Metyr, Mother of Fingers, through the microcosm held between her tail fingers. Soon, a second, golden star containing an Elden Beast arrived in the Lands Between. This Elden Beast was the Greater Will's vision for Order, and it would later become the Elden Ring. This beast was its vassal, and the living incarnation of the concept of Order. The Greater Will has other vassals and envoys known as the Two Fingers, who speak in a cipher sign language of light.

records.title: Land of Reeds
records.description:
thumb
The Land of Reeds (葦の地, Ashi no Chi) is a mentioned location in Elden Ring.
It is located outside the borders of the Lands Between and is said to be a place locked in a long and miserable civil war, which, over time, has caused its alienation from neighboring nations and left the entire land succumbed to a blood-soaked madness.

records.title: Lord of Frenzied Flame
records.description: The Lord of Frenzied Flame (狂い火の王, Kurui Hi no Ō), also known as the Lord of Chaos (混沌の王, Konton no Ō), is a status and title in the world of Elden Ring. It refers to the prophesied, messiah-like figure of the Frenzied Flame and its ailing followers. Promising them salvation from their torment, despair, their affliction, every sin, and every curse by melting it all away.

records.title: Lord of Frenzied Flame (ending)
records.description: The Lord of Frenzied Flame is one of the possible endings in Elden Ring.

records.title: Lord of Night

records.title: Memory Slots
records.description:
Memory Slots is a base stat in Elden Ring.
The Tarnished has two Memory Slots by default, and this amount can be increased through finding Memory Stones throughout the Lands Between. There is also a Talisman, Moon of Nokstella, which will increase the Tarnished's Memory Slots by 2. The Tarnished can have a maximum of 12 Memory Slots after finding all of the Memory Stones and equipping the Moon of Nokstella Talisman.
Memory Slots are used in order to equip Sorceries and Incantations at Sites of Grace, and must be set before magic can be used.
Category:Gameplay

records.title: Messmer's Flame Incantations
records.description: Messmer's Flame Incantations are a type of incantation in Shadow of the Erdtree. They channel the power of Messmerfire. Their effectiveness is boosted by the Fire Knight's Seal.

records.title: Messmerfire
records.description: Messmerfire or Messmer's Flame (メスメルの火, Mesumeru no Hi), also known as Messmer's Kindling (メスメルの種火, Mesumeru no Tanebi), is an inextinguishable dark-red flame that is strongly associated with Messmer the Impaler and his Fire Knights. It holds the destructive power of burning the sealing tree that blocks the entrance to Enir-Ilim, where the mysterious Gate of Divinity is located.

records.title: Meteoric Ore
records.description: was a metal in Elden Ring.

records.title: Miquella's Incantations
records.description: Miquella's incantations are a type of Incantation in Shadow of the Erdtree. These incantations are tied to Miquella, the revered Empyrean. They involve radiant, holy effects that deal damage and require Faith to cast. A catalyst must be equipped in order to cast these incantations.

records.title: Night of Black Knives
records.description: The Night of Black Knives (黒き刃の陰謀の夜, Kuroki Yaiba no Inbō no Yoru) was an event mentioned in Elden Ring. It involved the theft of Destined Death and the assassination of Godwyn the Golden, a son of Queen Marika the Eternal. It would serve as the catalyst of the conflict known as The Shattering.

records.title: One Great
records.description: The One Great was an unseen character mentioned in Elden Ring.

records.title: Outer God
records.description: The are unseen, enigmatic entities wielding immense power and influence over the world of Elden Ring, often acting indirectly to reshape the Lands Between according to their inscrutable designs. They manifest through various natural or supernatural phenomena, often tied to one or more divine elements.

records.title: Primeval Current
records.description:
The Primeval Current, also known as the procession of stars, is an unseen location in Elden Ring. 
The primeval current of glintstone sorcery is intrinsically tied to the cosmic vitality of the stars, shaping both the land and fate of the Lands Between. It is described as a torrent of glintstone flowing from a distant star cluster, often likened to a celestial procession of stars. However, its cosmic mysteries bewitch those who gaze into the current, often driving them to the brink of despair.

records.title: Primordial Gold
records.description: Primordial Gold is reddish-gold metal in Elden Ring.

records.title: Puppets
records.description: Puppets, including dolls and marionettes, are a type of being in Elden Ring and .

records.description: Ranni's Great Rune was a Great Rune mentioned in Elden Ring.

records.title: Red Lightning
records.description: Red Lightning, also known as Primordial Lightning, is a type of Lightning in Elden Ring. Characterized by its vibrant crimson hue, it deals Lightning damage.

records.title: Rotflower Tree
records.description: The Rotflower Tree is a Tree in Elden Ring.

records.title: Rune of Death
records.description: The Rune of Death (死のルーン, Shi no Rūn), also known as Destined Death (運命の死, Unmei no Shi), is an unobtainable Great Rune in Elden Ring that controls the fated deaths of the Demigods. Once part of the Elden Ring, it was removed by Queen Marika and sealed away when she established her Golden Order. It appears during the cutscene that plays when the player defeats Maliketh, the Black Blade at Crumbling Farum Azula.

records.title: Sap

records.title: Scadutree
records.description:
The Scadutree (影樹, Eiju; lit. "Shadow Tree") is a colossal tree in Elden Ring, included in the Shadow of the Erdtree expansion.
It is the shadow of the Erdtree which looms over the Land of Shadow, born of dark notions that bear no sense of Order, that twist and bend its stock, rendering it misshapen and brittle.

records.title: Seal
records.description: Seals are a type of magic in Elden Ring.

records.title: Second Defense of Leyndell
records.description: The was an event that occurred during the The Shattering in Elden Ring and Shadow of the Erdtree.

records.title: Second Liurnian War
records.description: The was an event that occurred during the Age of the Erdtree in Elden Ring and Shadow of the Erdtree. It was part of the Liurnian Wars, and ended when Radagon of the Golden Order cleansed himself with Celestial Dew and married Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon at the Church of Vows.

records.title: Serpents
records.description: Serpents, also known as Snakes, are types of reptilian creature in Elden Ring.

records.title: Servants of Rot Incantations
records.description: Servants of Rot Incantations, also known as rot incantations, are a type of incantation in Elden Ring. They are wielded primarily by the Servants of Rot. These incantations focus on inflicting Poison and Scarlet Rot status buildup, devastating enemies damage over time (DoT) effects.

records.title: Shadowbound Beast
records.description: Shadowbound Beasts (影従の獣, Eijuu no Kemono), also known as Shadows (影, Kage), are a concept in Elden Ring.

records.title: Shardbearers
records.description: The Shardbearers (破片の君主, Hahen no Kunshu) are special bosses that are key to progression in Elden Ring.

records.title: Siege of Caria Manor
records.description: The Siege of Caria Manor refers to the failed siege of Caria Manor, the home of the Carian Royal Family, by the Knights of the Cuckoo, the private army of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. It was the final battle in the Liurnian Civil War.

records.title: Silver
records.description: Silver is a metal associated with Arcane power in Elden Ring. It is closely tied to the Night and the artificial and mutable forms of life connected to the Eternal Cities, including Silver Tears and Albinaurics, as well as concepts of rebirth, mimicry, and hidden wealth.

records.title: Smithing
records.description: Smithing is a concept in Elden Ring.

records.title: Spiral Incantations
records.description:
Spiral Incantations are a type of incantation in Shadow of the Erdtree. They are derived from the golden sorceries used by the Hornsent Inquisitors of Enir-Ilim.
Spiral incantations focus on summoning spirals or arcs of light to attack foes, often with devastating and far-reaching effects. The Spiraltree Seal increases the effectiveness of these spells by 15%.

records.title: Spiraltree
records.description: The , also known as the spiral tree, is the sigil of a faction in the Shadow of the Erdtree expansion for Elden Ring.

records.title: Spirit World
records.description: The Spirit World is an unseen location in Elden Ring.

records.title: Spiritgrave
records.description: Spiritgraves are a concept in Elden Ring, introduced in the Shadow of the Erdtree DLC.

records.title: Starscourge Conflict
records.description: The Starscourge Conflict refers the clash between General Radahn and the stars of the night sky. Commonly described as a completely one-sided battle in Radahn's favor, the conclusion of this confrontation would earn the young warrior the title of "Starscourge" (星砕きの "Hoshi-Kudaki" literally meaning "star crusher" or "star smasher"), secure the safety of the town of sorcery, Sellia and would fetter the very movement of the stars, halting the fates they'd ordain for their subjects, which would include the fate of Lunar Princess Ranni, Radahn's own sister. From this day onward, only when Radahn has fully perished, will the stars ever dare to resume their movements.

records.title: Storm
records.description: The Storm is a concept in Elden Ring.

records.title: The Shattering
records.description: The Shattering (破砕戦争, Hasai Sensō) refers to the devastating and widespread war that broke out between Queen Marika the Eternal's offspring, and her demigod step-children, after the Elden Ring was shattered.

records.title: Thorn Sorceries
records.description: Thorn sorceries, also known as aberrant sorceries, are a type of sorcery in Elden Ring. These Faith-based spells damage the caster to summon cursed Briars of Sin that deal Magic damage and inflict Blood Loss upon their targets. Drawn from the heretical blood star and the forsaken Scadutree, thorn sorceries reflect the agonizing woe of those who wield them.

records.title: Trees
records.description: This page lists Trees in Elden Ring, Shadow of the Erdtree, and .

records.title: Tutelary Deity
records.description:
A tutelary deity is a god or spirit regarded as the guardian, patron, or protector of a specific location, natural feature, individual, lineage, nation, cultural group, or profession. The term "tutelary" derives from words associated with safety and thus of guardianship.
Hornsent aspired to ascend as tutelary deities by engaging in severe ascetic training to heighten their spirituality. The withered corpses of successful tutelary deities are enshrined across the Realm of Shadow, quietly gathering Revered Spirit Ash in their palms. Horned Warriors, Divine Beast Warriors, and others are inhabited by guardian spirits that protect Enir-Ilim. Some who failed became Curseblades instead.

records.title: Two Fingers Incantations
records.description: Two Fingers Incantations are a type of incantation in Elden Ring. These spells are used by the Tarnished and other servants of the Two Fingers. These incantations provide healing, status cures, and defensive benefits, alongside some stealth-based magic. The Finger Seal does not increase the effectiveness of Two Fingers incantations.

records.title: Verdigris
records.description: was an unusual metal in Elden Ring. Its corroded nature granted it bulk, weight, and the strength to protect others.

records.title: Wandering Mausoleum
records.description: Wandering Mausoleums are large, mobile structures in Elden Ring which serve as means to duplicate Remembrances.

records.title: War of the Ancient Dragons
